relevance_note: A cohort of 7 children with SLE and lymphoproliferation in which one girl carries a TNFAIP3 variant: 'WES revealed a heterozygous c.559C>T (p. Q187X) mutation in the TNFAIP3 gene in patient 7'.
method_note: Read the whole paper manually; a short Python script only assembled the JSON and checked spans and fields (no table transcription). Tables 1-3 and Figures 1-4 are present only as titles in the Markdown, so per-patient clinical and laboratory values (ages, skin, joints, inflammatory markers, other organs) are unavailable and left 'not reported'. Cohort of 7 SLE children with lymphoproliferation; only patient 7 (TNFAIP3 c.559C>T, p.Q187X) is in scope. Patients 1-4 (somatic NRAS), patient 6 (PIK3CD, previously reported in ref [23]) and patient 5 (no variant) get no rows. Patient 7 has no attributed variant in another gene ('no mutations in other genes associated with primary immunodeficiencies and monogenic SLE were identified in all patients'). Group inferences: features stated for 'all patients' (ANA >=1:320, elevated IgG, hepatomegaly and/or splenomegaly and/or lymphadenectasis, SLE classification, bone marrow without malignant cells), for 'the other patients' than patient 3 (increased IgE), and for the 6/6 'patients with mutations' (renal and hematologic involvement, recurrent fever; P5 is the only patient without a mutation) were applied to patient 7 with evidence_basis 'inferred from group statement'. Skin involvement was in 1 of the 6 patients with mutations, not identified, so it stays 'not reported'. Cytopenia is reported as hematologic SLE involvement; the paper does not say 'autoimmune' for patient 7, but the checklist item was marked observed. 'Normal' laboratory results for patient 7 (IgA, CD4+ T cells, NK cells) were recorded as excluded abnormalities. Relatives: the father carries the variant ('which is from her father'); the paper does not state his zygosity, phenotype or whether he is affected. The paper says the variant 'was not identified in her grandparents' without giving their number or which side of the family they are on; two rows were created (the minimum the plural implies), labelled 'grandparent of patient 7' and 'grandparent of patient 7 2'. Because the paper does not say these are the father's parents, the father's parental_testing_statement and inheritance are 'not reported'. is_proband for patient 7 is null: the paper never uses 'proband' or 'index case'. Inconsistencies noted: (1) Results list disease flares on tapering in patients 1, 3, 4 and 7, while the Discussion lists flares on prednisolone taper to 1.25-5 mg/day in '3 patients (1, 3, and 4)'; (2) the Abstract says protein levels were measured 'in patients with gene mutations by western blot', but Methods and Results describe BIM western blots only for the 4 NRAS patients, so no functional evidence is recorded for the TNFAIP3 variant; (3) the NRAS variant is given as c.38 A>G (p.G13C) in the text and c.38G>A (p.G13D) in the Figure 2 legend (out-of-scope patients); (4) the protein change is printed 'p.Q187X' in the Abstract and Results and 'p. Q187X' in the Discussion.
